scope: bounded takeover risk audit and next-session visual stack

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: Both AM_RangeAttack and AM_Melusina_BowAttack_Gameplay use DefaultSlot, and the current ABP has no connected upper/lower-body blend.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: Aim/draw can lock locomotion or snap the full body; moving aim will feel clumsy even after a corrected clip exists.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Muse must validate the corrected candidate on V2, then add a scoped upper-body layer and live Morning proof.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: BowDraw_v2 candidate root track has scale 100 while the canonical root is scale 1.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: Binding it directly can produce enormous or invalid FK transforms and misleading pose previews.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Duplicate/correct candidate root and baked travel before any montage binding.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: HUD was globally compacted to 65% in source but has not been rebuilt or viewed in PIE.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: Panels may become readable, too small, or move inward together because the whole design scales around the screen center.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Build, capture Morning idle/aim/target/sequence states, and check duplicate reticle ownership.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: Arrow spawn uses actor location plus camera ray offset, not the hand_l socket.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: The projectile can look detached from the bow or appear to originate inside the character during camera changes.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Measure spawn-to-hand distance in PIE before changing origin; if visible, use a narrow presentation offset or socket-derived origin while preserving camera aim direction.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: 60 FPS harness now has a performance-only mode, but it has no live foreground result for the current HUD/Niagara build.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: A previous ~38 FPS observation may be mistaken for the current baseline, or a background 3 FPS run may be treated as valid.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Run foreground performance-only smoke first, then a separate showcase capture.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: The practice slime fixture is present but ground placement/reachability and the second party pawn mapping remain unproven.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: A visually polished screenshot can still use the wrong target or duplicate Melusina pawn.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: Verify target bounds/ground and stock Sir roster class before showcase capture.

risks_that_can_bite_later.finding: Fresh chord, GOOD/PERFECT, once-only HP, restart and packaged evidence are still absent.
risks_that_can_bite_later.impact: Visual polish can hide a broken gameplay authority path.
risks_that_can_bite_later.gate: One short evidence pass after visual smoke: five shots, one slime hit, FLOW→SEQUENCE→FLOW, HP/callback counts.
